name: container-recreation
argv: --command=set -eu; sudo systemctl restart remission-simulation.service; sudo systemctl is-active remission-simulation.service; printf "BOOT_ID "; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf "DISK_UUID "; sudo blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/disk/by-id/google-remission-data; sudo stat -c "%d:%i %s %n" /srv/remission/data/remission.sqlite /srv/remission/data/remission.sqlite.admission.lock; sudo docker inspect --format '{"Name":{{json .Name}},"Id":{{json .Id}},"Image":{{json .Image}},"Status":{{json .State.Status}},"OOMKilled":{{.State.OOMKilled}}}' remission-simulation-app-1 remission-simulation-generator-1 remission-simulation-proxy-1
